name: @teamnova-sri-ko-lms/infrastructure
description: Infrastructure as code for the SRI-KO Learning Management System — Dockerfiles, Compose stacks, CI/CD workflows, deployment scripts, and the SRI-KO LMS Stack Deploy action
author: TeamNova · University of Kelaniya

scripts.lint: npm run lint:yaml && npm run lint:shell && npm run lint:docker
scripts.compose:config: for f in compose/docker-compose*.yml; do docker compose --env-file .env.example -f "$f" config --quiet || exit 1; done && echo '✓ every compose stack resolves'
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run validate && npm run compose:config
scripts.build:frontend: docker build -f docker/frontend.Dockerfile --target runtime --build-context infra=. -t sri-ko-lms-frontend:local "${APP_PATH:-../../SRI-KO_Application_Project/SRI-KO_LMS_MERN}"
